mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SKU_MASTER ( COMPANY_CODE, SKU, SKU_NAME, SKU_TYPE, UNIT, SPEC, REMARK, USE_YN, TAX_YN, CREATED_BY, CREATE_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{companyCode}, #{sku}, #{skuName}, #{skuType}, #{unit}, #{spec}, #{remark}, NVL(#{useYn}, 'Y'), NVL(#{taxYn}, 'Y'), NVL(#{createdBy}, 'ADMIN'), SYSDATE, NVL(#{updatedBy}, 'ADMIN'), SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SKU_MASTER SET SKU_NAME = #{skuName}, SKU_TYPE = #{skuType}, UNIT = #{unit}, SPEC = #{spec}, REMARK = #{remark}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, TAX_YN = #{taxYn}, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND SKU = #{sku}
mapper.select: SELECT 'S' || LPAD( NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(SKU, 2))), 0) + 1, 5, '0' ) FROM TB_SKU_MASTER WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND SKU LIKE 'S%'
